descriptions.notStarted: So it seems that if I want to conduct a thorough search on Ereve in search of the Master of Disguise, I'll have to first receive a Investigation Permit. I better talk to #p1101002#.
descriptions.inProgress: He claims that due to handing out too many Investigation Permits in times like this, the Investigation Permits have actually run out. He then asked me if I could get him some #t4005004#s so he can issue new Investigation Permits...
descriptions.completed: I gave #p1101002# some #t4005004#s, and received a Investigation Permit in return. It's now time for me to conduct a thorough search of Ereve.
